beats.care: Turned 18 or moved recently? The final list comes out on 9 November. If you're not on it, you can't vote.
beats.what: In the voter-list re-check (SIR), Hyderabad added 29,226 voters and removed 2,066 by 7 Oct, the most changes in Telangana.
beats.why: People sent in 1.93 lakh Form 6 requests to join the list, and 6,335 Form 7 requests to remove names.

cards.body: Telangana's Chief Electoral Office released the numbers. Statewide, 12,204 names were removed and 51,821 new voters cleared so far. The final voter list will be published on 9 November.
Within the city, Jubilee Hills got the most requests to remove names: 1,026.

cards.q: Which form adds your name to the voter list?
cards.why: Form 6 is for new voters. Form 7 is for objecting to or deleting a name.

cards.q: Have you checked your name on the voter list?

hook: Hyderabad just added *29,226 voters*. Is your name on the list?
